arithmetic_scope: For finite nonnegative scores and IEEE-RNE additions, the parent masked sum has one selected nonzero score plus zeros; carrying that score preserves the modeled result. Finite ties pick the same absolute smallest expert index independent of tree order.
NaN comparator is not associative; same pair predicate and same-tree tests do not establish matching NaN results after backend tree/layout changes. NaN payload bits were not certified.

Negative-zero payload and a deliberately FTZ-add subnormal model are retained counterexamples. Normal finite sigmoid output does not have negative zero; actual GPU subnormal/lowering behavior remains subject to official correctness.
No actual Triton compilation, GPU execution or universal bit-equivalence proof was performed by this reviewer. Tuple JIT API compatibility is source/API evidence only.

fixed_pre_result_gate.confidence: Operational consistency screen; overlapping intervals remain explicit and no causal inference from router profile duration alone.
fixed_pre_result_gate.failure_policy: One fixed attempt; no threshold lowering, noise-seeking repeat or automatic public promotion.
fixed_pre_result_gate.flags: none; checks and return status clean
fixed_pre_result_gate.provenance: exact source, full evaluator inventory and case/profile identity

parent_activation.candidate_requirement: Report actual profile paths. Unchanged route_a/route_b fallback remains possible and must not be labeled changed-path evidence.

performance_hypothesis: One collective reduction replaces two per selection, potentially removing separate cross-warp synchronization/layout work. It does not establish fewer scalar shuffles, emitted barriers or a speedup; extra payload register/select cost may offset it.

primary_sources.supports: argmax comparator/tie behavior and sigmoid definition
tuple reduce argument grouping, @jit combiner requirement, and two-field argmax construction

source_findings: Exactly two selected route loops replace argmax plus masked score sum with a three-field tuple reduction; one six-argument @triton.jit combiner is added.
Comparator uses the exact Triton3.8.0 finite-value/left-index tie predicate. The helper returns value,index,payload in the same grouping that tl.reduce supplies as its two input tuples.

Payload is the original sigmoid score. All eight sequential selections/exclusions, weight normalization, local-ID mapping, output casts, pooled RMS normalization, UV reset and PDL source are unchanged.
All CUDA strings, preparation, dispatch, tuning and other source restore to the exact97af parent. Unchanged CUDA extension names are appropriate because their source is unchanged.
toolchain_limit: Modal reports Triton3.8.0; this does not independently pin the official worker installed standard.py bytes.
